hero.title: The communications platform for <accent>modern campaigns.</accent>
hero.subtitle: AI-drafted content. Human-reviewed. Fully compliant. Run your entire communications operation from one command center.

features.title: Everything your campaign needs to communicate.
features.subtitle: Purpose-built for political campaigns, every feature is designed to meet the unique demands of election law, compliance, and campaign operations.

aiContent.label: AI content generation
aiContent.desc: Draft social posts, press releases, emails, and talking points in seconds. Every piece is tailored to your campaign's brand voice.

approvalWorkflow.label: Human approval workflow
approvalWorkflow.desc: Route every piece of content through role-based review before it ever goes public. Complete chain of custody.

disclosures.label: Automatic disclosures
disclosures.desc: Jurisdiction-aware disclosure rules applied instantly. State-specific AI disclosure requirements are handled automatically.

opponentMonitoring.label: Opponent monitoring
opponentMonitoring.desc: Track what the other side is saying in real time. Identify rebuttal opportunities before they become dominant narratives.

spendControls.label: Spend controls
spendControls.desc: Set monthly cost caps per campaign. Track AI drafting, video generation, and voice synthesis against your campaign budget.

auditTrail.label: Full audit trail
auditTrail.desc: Every action is logged with actor, timestamp, and context. FEC-ready records at your fingertips come disclosure season.

workflow.title: From brief to published in minutes, not days.

draft.title: Draft in seconds
draft.desc: Describe what you need. PolitIQ's AI drafts press releases, social posts, email blasts, and talking points instantly.

review.title: Review and approve
review.desc: Content is routed to your approval team. Managers, approvers, and legal all get the right view at the right time.

publish.title: Publish with confidence
publish.desc: Disclosures are auto-applied by jurisdiction before anything goes live. One click to publish across every platform.
